senses.gloss:
ITA-1.7.4 ananuyojyam अननुयोज्यम्
Unquestionable statement
A statement which has exhausted the scope for further questioning.

ITA-5.67.8 anantavātaḥ अनन्तवातः
Trigeminal neuralgia
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain in the neck region; pain in nape of neck; pain residing at eyes; pain residing at eyebrows; pain residing at temporal region; pulsating sensation at zygomatic region; eye diseases; lockjaw/catching sensation over jaw; pain in neck; severe pain in nape of neck; pain in eyes; pain in eyebrows; pain in temporal region; pulsating sensation in zygomatic region; lockjaw/catching sensation over jaw; other eye diseases.

ITA-6.2.7.2 Abhaktam, anannam अभक्तम्, अनन्नम्
Administration of medicine on empty stomach

ITA-3.2.4.3 ānanam आननम्
Face, mouth

ITA-8.3.27 anamlasūpaḥ अनम्लसूपः
Soup without added sour substances
A soup prepared without adding any sour substance.

ITA-9.6.201 anavabaddhaśalyam अनवबद्धशल्यम्
Loosely lodged foreign body
A foreign body which is loosely impacted or hanging in the body.

ITA-9.6.203 anavabaddhaśalyoddharaṇapanchadeshahetuḥ अनवबद्धशल्योद्धरणपन्छदेशहेतुः
Procedures for removal of loosely impacted foreign body
Fifteen extraction measures for removal of a loosely impacted foreign body

ITA-1.6.5 anāgatavekṣaṇam अनागतवेक्षणम्
Prospective crossreferencing
A prospective reference to statements from forthcoming chapters or sections of a text that are relevant to the topic being discussed.

ITA-1.9.3.2.16 anādi अनादि
Without beginning
A process or state whose beginning cannot be ascertained.

ITA-3.8.29 anāmikā अनामिका
Ring finger
Also denotes fourth toe.

ITA-6.2.6.61 anāyuṣyam अनायुष्यम्
Life span-reducing
Life span-limiting substances.

ITA-5.19.2 annajāhikkā अन्नजाहिक्का
Hiccup due to improper A disorder characterized by hiccups unrelated to any activity swallowing of food associated with sneezing; hiccups reduced with drinking or eating; hiccups decreased with wholesome and suitable foods or liquids; hiccups traversing upwards; painless; with little sound.

ITA-5.34.13 annadravaśūlaḥ अन्नद्रवशूलः
Persistent, continuous abdominal pain
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain occurring before food has been digested; pain occurring after food has been digested; pain not subsiding despite consuming food; pain not subsiding on an empty stomach.

ITA-9.4.33 annaprāśanasaṁskāraḥ अन्नप्राशनसंस्कारः
Weaning ceremony
A ceremony performed during the period of infancy (6 to 10 months) in which the first intake of semi-solid or solid food is initiated.

IT.3.11.45 annamārgaḥ अन्नमार्गः
Oesophagus

ITA-9.2.35 annalepana अन्नलेपन
Application of paste prepared with shastika rice
An application of medicated paste prepared with rice cooked in milk.

ITA-2.5.9 annavahasrotaḥ अन्नवहस्रोतः
Digestive tract
The pathway for food in the process of digestion.

ITA-5.5.4 annavahasrotoduṣṭiḥ अन्नवहस्रोतोदुष्टिः
Vitiation of channels carrying food
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: an aversion to food; loss of taste; indigestion; vomiting.

ITA-5.73.25 annavahasrotoviddhaḥ अन्नवहस्रोतोविद्धः
Injury to the gastrointestinal tract
A disorder characterized by abdominal distension; aversion to food; vomiting; blindness; pain; thirst; death.

IT.3.11.22 āmāśayaḥ, annasampuṭam, annāśayaḥ आमाशयः, अन्नसंपुटम्, अन्नाशयः
Stomach
The primary functional area of kapha and pitta.

ITA-9.4.8 annādaḥ/ annāśī अन्नादः/अन्नाशी
Child consuming solid food
A child depending predominantly on solid food for its nourishment.
